name: Tulfer Hütte
kurzbeschreibung: **Tulfer Hütte** in **Tulfes** – a cozy alpine refuge nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, just a short hike from the charming village of **Tulfes**. Surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery, this traditional **Tiroler** hut offers hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh **Tiroler** specialties. Whether you're seeking relaxation, stunning hikes, or a taste of authentic **Tiroler** hospitality, the **Tulfer Hütte** is your perfect alpine retreat.
